summary: Prepare for a hilarious and addictive experience with 69, a uniquely crafted casual fast-clicker game that will test your reflexes and tickle your funny bone. Each level completion is a testament to your skill, a small victory in a world of chaotic fun. Immerse yourself in a truly bizarre narrative drawn (very loosely!) from the true story of a rapper hilariously mistaken for colored candy. It's an experience you won't soon forget!
